errors.text_span: Оста Y също няма текстово наименование и не съдържа числови етикети или скала по вертикалата.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the y-axis doesn't have labels. The y-axis values are indicated next to the lines in the graph.
The description does not specify that the lines are labeled directly with numerical values which are part of the y-axis information.
While the description mentions changes, it should state more explicitly that the chart illustrates the trend of building permits issued over time.
